title: Membership in the head coalition
statement: For natural numbers $k,m$ and an index $i\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$, the index obtained by placing $i$ in the first summand of the disjoint union of sets of sizes $k$ and $m$ belongs to the coalition of the first $k$ indices in a set of size $k+m$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index in a set of size $k$
